decisions.reason: Although it uses the firm's fabrication and coating skills, the ceiling or floor pipe bracket is a more standard, less distinctive extension of the range and its weak later visibility suggests limited learning and payoff relative to core infrastructure products.
The pipe support bracket fits closely with the firm's existing project, welding, and pipeline-component knowledge, so customer feedback can still be absorbed and used to refine it commercially.

The public waste bin draws on metalworking and powder-coating capabilities but is too far from the firm's accumulated application knowledge and core offer to justify continued commitment over nearer opportunities.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray line is more distant than pipeline products but its several models, coating know-how, and overlap with municipal buyers give the firm enough basis to learn and tailor it further.

Outdoor public ashtrays are a narrower and more weakly related diversification, so the firm's absorptive capacity is less likely to generate improvements and sales momentum than in its established business.
